entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit Support. My name is Alex, agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
I need to return something.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and the order number, please?
Sarah Jenkins. Order is... 947B-331.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 24th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken. I just changed my mind.
I see. So it's fully functional, you've just decided against keeping it?
Yes. It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it. I want to send it back.

I understand. Looking at the delivery date, I see it's been about 16 days since you received it. For the VeloBand Pulse specifically, because it's a device that gets activated and linked to a personal account, our return policy for preference-based reasons is within 10 days of delivery.
Seriously? Ten days? That's ridiculous.

I can appreciate why that would be frustrating, Sarah. The policy is in place due to the device's activation process and for hygiene protocols. Since we're past that 10-day window, I'm unable to process a refund for it.
Of course. So I'm just out the money then. Fine.

Not at all. While a direct return isn't an option, what most of our customers in this situation do is use the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It’s a secure platform we set up for customers to sell their gear to other VeloFit users. You can often get very close to the original price for a new, unused device.
So I have to sell it myself? Whatever. I guess that's better than nothing.
It's a very popular option, and we make it as simple as possible. I can email you a direct link to the resale marketplace page with instructions on how to create a listing. Would that work for you?
Yeah, send the link.
Perfect. I've just sent that email to the address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
No, that's it.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great rest of your day.
